description: This file defines a custom exception class 'RomNotFoundException' used within the 'com.romraider.xml' package for indicating missing ROM files in the RomRaider project.

classes.name: RomNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a ROM file was not found. It extends the standard Java Exception class and provides a constructor that accepts an error message.

methods.name: RomNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new instance of RomNotFoundException with a specified detail message.
